title: Bound a helper to one large failed-log question

rubric.text: Permits a read-only helper only for the supplied single large-log question, with the exact PR/head/log identity and bounded result format; rejects polling, broad triage and repairs in its brief.
Selects actual log-reading capability rather than a reviewer role name, gives the helper an existing checkout if needed without a worker slot, and allows no further delegation.

Separates capability and model selection; uses Luna/low for the supplied exact extraction task, leaves the lead unchanged, and preserves the alternative Sol model pin while resolving unspecified effort through the supplied policy.
The controller interprets the bounded evidence and retains triage, repair, replies, pushes, resolution, retries and merge authority; no operations occur during this review-only case.
